claude.performance_metric: merged into Select Income REIT and deregistered Jan 2015 at $10.50 cash / 0.36 SIR share; no in-window standalone record
claude.rationale: The slice documents only that the registrant merged into SIR and deregistered in January 2015, with no standalone public record covering the fixed ~2016-2018 outcome window. The only integration-related lines are forward-looking risk factors ("costs or difficulties related to the integration...will be greater than expected"; "disruption of management's attention...may be greater than expected"), which the slice explicitly labels "stated risk factors, not documented realized results." Because no realized post-deal disruption at the product/process (p4) or process/organization (p5) interface is documented, both are coded uncertain rather than 0, consistent with the slice's explicit UNCERTAIN (no public standalone record) coding.

grok.performance_metric: merged into SIR and deregistered Jan 2015; no 2016-2018 standalone record
grok.rationale: The slice states that integration-related statements (costs/difficulties of integrating operations, operating-cost and management-attention disruption) are disclosed only as forward-looking risk factors, not as documented realized results. Within the fixed ~2016-2018 window there is no standalone public record after the January 2015 merger into SIR and Form 15 deregistration, so no realized product/process or process/organization disruption is documented; absence of such evidence codes p4_pathway and p5_pathway as 0.

openai.performance_metric: absorbed into SIR and deregistered in January 2015; 2016-2018 standalone outcome not documented
openai.rationale: No realized product/process disruption is documented because the former registrant’s standalone portfolio trajectory was not separately disclosed during 2016-2018. Likewise, no realized process/organization fracture is documented; the cited integration difficulties and management disruption were expressly forward-looking risk factors rather than realized outcomes.
